mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, directly increasing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 2.0% fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals imminent monetary tightening, which elevates equity discount rates and reduces forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.3pp fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates tight labor market conditions that support corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained earnings momentum.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 3.5% fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating labor market strength, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE decline > 0.2pp fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% monthly indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST and RSAFS growth > 0.5% MoM fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (high GDP growth and low unemployment), elevated retail sales (RSAFS) above 520,000 signals consumer spending saturation, triggering profit-taking and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, RSAFS above 520,000 fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 105.0 indicates strong manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through supply chain resilience.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 105.0 fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing contraction, which reduces corporate earnings visibility and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline > 0.5% fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances (p>0.05 t-test vs baseline) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
